findings.title: No HSTS header on any response
findings.description: Strict-Transport-Security absent from every response header sampled including homepage and Shop.
findings.recommendation: Add at Cloudflare/Kinsta edge; start without preload, add preload after one verified release cycle.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header
findings.description: CSP absent from every response sampled.
findings.recommendation: Deploy report-only first given the large third-party script surface (GTM, Elementor, Google Fonts, YITH).

findings.title: No X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors
findings.description: No clickjacking protection on any page including checkout.
findings.recommendation: Add X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN at the edge.

findings.title: No Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy
findings.description: Neither header present anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Add strict-origin-when-cross-origin and a conservative Permissions-Policy.

findings.title: Bacteriostatic Water product is a genuine orphan page
findings.description: The claimed 'cart upsell' mitigation is an AJAX toggle with no <a href>, not a crawlable link. Sitemap-only discovery, zero internal PageRank flow.
findings.recommendation: Add one real hyperlink from a relevant product page or FAQ.

findings.title: Case-variant Page URLs serve 200 without redirecting
findings.description: WordPress Page routes (/Shop/, /Contact/, /FAQ/, /Cart/) are case-insensitive and don't redirect, though each renders a correct lowercase canonical. Custom-post-type routes (Product, Testing) are correctly case-sensitive and 404.
findings.recommendation: Add a 301 case-normalization rule for Page routes at the edge.

categories.name: Above-the-fold / SXO
what_works: Real page content (product data, COA batch evidence, hero copy) is confirmed present in the raw HTTP response body, not withheld server-side
A new 'Why Pep Select is different' homepage differentiation section has been added since 8/19

findings.title: Full-viewport gate blocks 100% of first paint on every device
findings.description: Screenshot and DOM measurement confirm #psag-gate exactly covers the full viewport on both 390x844 and 1440x900 before any interaction.
findings.recommendation: This is a business/compliance decision, not a pure engineering fix. Present two paths to the owner: (a) keep fully blocking but make it genuinely accessible, or (b) reduce blocking severity.

findings.title: Gate accessibility sub-claims not supported by markup
findings.description: aria-describedby is absent; the Exit link has no href (JS-only, out of tab order); zero inert/aria-hidden anywhere on the page; no focus-trap code exists. This contradicts the prior 'Live code verified' status for 4 of 8 specific sub-claims.
findings.recommendation: Add aria-describedby, a real href on Exit, and either a focus trap or inert on background content.

findings.title: Exit link sends visitors off-site to Google with no on-site alternative
findings.description: Confirmed via gate script: window.location.href = 'https://google.com', and the link has no href attribute at all.
findings.recommendation: Add a real href; consider an on-site informational alternative.

findings.title: Gate legal text below 16px on mobile
findings.description: Computed font-size 10.5-14px across 4 measured text nodes.
findings.recommendation: Increase to >=16px.
